# Bélinac

> > Bélinac is a French luxury fabric manufacturer specializing in high-end silks, linings, and textiles for fashion designers and interior furnishings since 1848.

Maison Bélinac produces premium fabrics including dupion silk, Bemberg linings, and specialty textiles for wedding dresses, haute couture, and professional furnishing applications. The company represents French textile heritage and craftsmanship.
